play.definition: A defensive play result in which the quarterback begins or remains in a passing posture, retains possession of the football, and is contacted and controlled by one or more defenders behind the line of scrimmage before completing a forward pass. The quarterback may be wrapped and brought to the ground, tripped, driven backward, forced out of bounds, or ruled down while under defensive control. The defining observable sequence is defensive access to the quarterback followed by contact, control, and termination of the play behind the line of scrimmage.

action.label: None
action.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

action.label: Pull Ball
action.definition: A quarterback's action of removing the football from the running back during or immediately after the mesh to retain possession on an option, read-option, or run-pass option play.

action.label: Read Defender
action.definition: A general action where an offensive player (often the quarterback or a ball carrier) observes the movements and alignment of a defensive player to make a decision about their next action (e.g., throwing to a specific receiver, cutting during a run, or deciding to hand off).

action.label: Throw Pass
action.definition: A quarterback's or other eligible passer's action of propelling the football forward with a legal throwing motion toward an intended receiver.
